narrative.northStar: A clear path to an appointment
narrative.overview: The user requested simple patient and clinic workflows in place of the information-heavy homepage. The portal at `/` uses the Operate mode recorded in `.impeccable/surface-brief.md`: choose a time, enter details, and confirm. Navy text, violet actions, pale surfaces, Nunito Sans, and health icons retain the earlier approachable identity.
dos: Do keep booking, lookup, and schedule management understandable without API knowledge.
Do show real availability, confirmations, errors, and cancellation state.
Do preserve visible focus, local-time labels, and usable narrow-screen layouts.
donts: Don't move JSON examples or setup instructions back into the patient flow.
Don't imply that email lookup or clinic navigation provides sign-in or access control.
Don't invent doctors, ratings, availability counts, or security guarantees.
